news.headline: 輝達單日暴跌 14%
news.plain: 華爾街日報與 Reuters 報導，美國證管會（SEC，類似台灣的金管會）正在調查輝達過去的揭露是否誤導投資人；週五又傳出調查涉及會計處理，股價單日跌 14%。
news.plain_en: WSJ and Reuters report the SEC (the US securities regulator, like Taiwan’s FSC) is probing whether NVIDIA’s disclosures misled investors; on Friday reports that the probe covers accounting sent the stock down 14%.
news.why_me: 你持有 81 股。已有投資人提起集體訴訟（涵蓋 2025/10～2026/11 買進的人），請保留你的買進紀錄。
news.why_me_en: You hold 81 shares. A class action covers buyers from Oct 2025 to Nov 2026, so keep your purchase records.
news.source: Reuters（引述華爾街日報，The Star 轉載）

news.headline: 美股一週跌 8.6%，正式進入修正
news.headline_en: US stocks fall 8.6% in a week, enter a correction
news.plain: 標普 500 連跌 7 天，距離 10 月高點超過 10%。市場擔心 AI 的龐大投資回收不了。
news.plain_en: The S&P 500 fell 7 days in a row and is more than 10% below its October high. Investors worry the huge AI spending won’t pay off.
news.why_me: 股市下跌時，你一半以上是現金，總資產受到的衝擊比較小。
news.why_me_en: With over half your assets in cash, a stock drop hits your total wealth less.
news.source: 美聯社 AP（Washington Times 轉載）

news.headline: 台股上週五重挫 6%，今天政府出手護盤
news.headline_en: Taiwan stocks fell 6% Friday; government steps in today
news.plain: 金管會限制放空，國安基金進場，台股今天開低後一度大漲上千點。
news.plain_en: The FSC restricted short selling and the National Stabilization Fund stepped in; TAIEX opened lower, then rallied over 1,000 points.
news.why_me: 護盤能減緩下跌速度，但不代表已經止跌。
news.why_me_en: Support can slow the fall, but it doesn’t mean the bottom is in.

news.headline: Google 推出新一代自研 AI 晶片
news.headline_en: Google launches new in-house AI chips
news.plain: Google 自己做的晶片（TPU）可以減少對輝達的依賴。
news.plain_en: Google’s own chips (TPUs) reduce its reliance on NVIDIA.
news.why_me: 對 GOOG 是好事，對 NVDA 是長期壓力，兩者剛好互相平衡。
news.why_me_en: Good for GOOG, long-term pressure on NVDA; the two partly offset in your portfolio.
